meta.name: opencode-memory
meta.description: Maintain a persistent memory file (AGENTS.md) for OpenCode and Claude Code projects — equivalent to CLAUDE.md. Use this skill whenever the user mentions OpenCode, AGENTS.md, project memory, session context, or wants to capture/update project knowledge so it persists across coding sessions. Trigger even for casual mentions like "remember this for next time", "update the project file", "save our decisions", "I use opencode", or "keep track of what we built". This skill creates, reads, and updates the AGENTS.md file with project structure, build/run commands, and a changelog of key decisions.
